1.w: A song, a psalm of David. I am determined, O God. I will sing and praise you with my whole heart.

2.w: Awake, O stringed instrument and harp. I will wake up at dawn.

3.w: I will give you thanks before the nations, O Lord . I will sing praises to you before foreigners.

4.w: For your loyal love extends beyond the sky, and your faithfulness reaches the clouds.

5.w: Rise up above the sky, O God. May your splendor cover the whole earth.

6.w: Deliver by your power and answer me, so that the ones you love may be safe.

7.w: God has spoken in his sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem; the Valley of Sukkoth I will measure off.

8.w: Gilead belongs to me, as does Manasseh. Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my royal scepter.

9.w: Moab is my washbasin. I will make Edom serve me. I will shout in triumph over Philistia.”

10.w: Who will lead me into the fortified city? Who will bring me to Edom?

11.w: Have you not rejected us, O God? O God, you do not go into battle with our armies.

12.w: Give us help against the enemy, for any help men might offer is futile.

13.w: By God’s power we will conquer; he will trample down our enemies.
